about.description: MIDAS is the ecosystem token for Midas, a tokenization platform that issues liquid, yield-bearing tokens designed to track institutional-style strategies such as treasury exposure, credit, and other structured yield sleeves. Midas positions these tokens as building blocks for DeFi, aiming to make traditionally gated strategies accessible in a transferable format while keeping the product experience focused on NAV-like performance and predictable yield. MIDAS supports governance and incentives across the Midas product ecosystem.
